scripts.verify:node: node -e "const major=Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0]); if(major!==24){console.error('Phase 4 VS01 browser harness requires Node 24'); process.exit(1)}"
scripts.check: npm run verify:node && npm run test:self && npm run test:policy && npm run test:real:list
scripts.test:real:list: npm run verify:node && playwright test --config=playwright.config.mjs --list && node scripts/verify-playwright-json.mjs
scripts.install:chromium: npm run verify:node && playwright install chromium
